records.Entity / project type: historical Bitcoin collection branch / cross-chain provenance project
records.Concise description: A 535-piece Bitcoin Ordinals branch of DeGods made from previously burned Solana DeGods and inscribed together on Bitcoin in early 2023.
records.Deeper researched summary: BTC DeGods is a distinct 535-piece Bitcoin branch of the broader DeGods project. DeGods’ own 2023 communications announced 535 DeGods on Bitcoin, and the current DeGods site still recognizes BTC DeGods as a collection category. Contemporary founder interviews and reporting document that the images corresponded to DeGods previously burned from the original Solana supply and were inscribed together on Bitcoin before a public distribution/mint. The Bitcoin branch is finite and primarily historically significant today, so MSC gives the 535-piece subset one Ordinals profile while relating it to the broader DeGods ecosystem rather than creating a generic cross-chain DeGods profile.
Creators / founders: Frank (Rohun Vora) — DeGods founder and principal public project lead
records.Launch / history: The 535 Bitcoin inscriptions were announced in February 2023; a public distribution/mint for the BTC DeGods followed in March 2023.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: BTC DeGods was an unusually early, high-profile migration/provenance experiment from an established non-Bitcoin NFT community and helped demonstrate that Ordinals could host a distinct Bitcoin branch of an existing collection.
Important technical or cultural characte: Cross-chain cultural/provenance relationship that is not Bitcoin-consensus-enforced

Official sources.label: DeGods current gallery — BTC DeGods category

Corroborating sources.label: Decrypt — DeGods founders on the 535 burned DeGods inscribed on Bitcoin

records.Verification basis: Current DeGods first-party site plus archived official DeGods Bitcoin announcement and contemporary founder interview/reporting.
Research notes / uncertainties: Treat BTC DeGods as the distinct 535-piece Bitcoin branch; do not create a duplicate generic DeGods profile inside ORDINALS.
The relationship to prior Solana assets is project provenance/history, not something Bitcoin consensus itself recognizes.

records.Concise description: A 5,555-piece recursive Ordinals PFP collection led by 13 with art by Spiralgaze, with an official related BASED•ANGELS•RUNE distribution.
records.Deeper researched summary: Based Angels is a 5,555-piece recursive PFP collection inscribed in May 2024. The official project site identifies 13 as project lead and Spiralgaze as artist, describes the collection as a Bitcoin derivative/companion in the Remilio/Milady aesthetic lineage, and documents two related projects: Based Angels Honoraries and BASED•ANGELS•RUNE. Current project channels remained active through 2026. MSC keeps the Ordinals collection as the canonical entity here while treating the related Rune as a RUNES-category relationship rather than a duplicate Ordinals profile.
records.Launch / history: Inscribed/launched in May 2024 as 5,555 recursive PFPs; BASED•ANGELS•RUNE was etched and airdropped to holders later that month.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: Based Angels adds a well-documented later-era example of recursive PFP construction, persistent 2026 community operation, and a clean Ordinals-to-Runes relationship.
records.Verification basis: Current official project site for identity, supply, creators, launch and Rune relationship plus current 2026 project-channel activity.
Research notes / uncertainties: BASED•ANGELS•RUNE belongs canonically in RUNES if/when token-level Rune entities are included; link it here rather than duplicating it.
Derivative aesthetic lineage is cultural/project framing and does not imply affiliation with the originating Ethereum projects.

records.Concise description: King’s early 2023 Ordinals collection, notable for having individual community members inscribe their own Babbies during mint rather than relying on a single pre-inscribed collection drop.
records.Deeper researched summary: Bitcoin Babbies is an early large Ordinals PFP/art project by King. King’s current artist site describes it as the first Ordinals collection inscribed by its community and frames the launch as a milestone that onboarded thousands from Ethereum into Bitcoin art. The project account remained active in 2026. Current indexers disagree on the exact item total, so MSC records the distinctive community-inscribed launch model and creator attribution without locking an unqualified supply figure.
records.Launch / history: Launched in March 2023 during the early large-collection phase of Ordinals, using a community-inscribed mint/distribution model.
records.Why it matters in the Ordinals ecosystem: Bitcoin Babbies adds a distinct early distribution/inscription model to the canon: holders/community members inscribed the works themselves, making the project historically different from pre-inscribed or centrally inscribed collection drops.

Official sources.label: King / ABBF artist history — Bitcoin Babbies
